✝️ Christian Homeschool Learning

Kingdom Quest
Academy

"A Christian homeschool adventure where learning becomes a quest."

Kingdom Quest Academy helps children learn through Bible-centered lessons, interactive quests, boss battles, rewards, and parent-guided progress tracking. Pre-K through 5th Grade — completely free and offline.

⚔️ Enter the Academy Explore Features ↓
✝️ Bible-Centered 🔒 100% Offline 👨‍👩‍👧 Multi-Profile 🎓 Pre-K to 5th Grade 💰 Free

Built for Christian homeschool families.

What's Inside

Everything Your Family Needs to Learn Together

Ten subjects, a full scope & sequence from Pre-K to 5th Grade, and a reward system that keeps children genuinely motivated.

✝️
Bible-Based Learning

Every subject is grounded in a Christian worldview. Daily verses, 24 devotionals, 16 Bible adventure stories, and memory verse practice.

⚔️
Boss Battles & Quests

Finish each subject and face a boss battle that tests what your child has learned — turning assessment into adventure.

📚
10 Core Subjects

Reading, Math, Spelling, Vocabulary, Writing, Science, History, Geography, Life Skills, and Bible — all in one app.

🏆
Rewards & Achievements

Children earn coins, care for pets, build a village, and unlock 54 achievement badges as they complete lessons.

🔐
Parent Dashboard

PIN-protected parent area with detailed progress tracking, accuracy stats, attendance calendar, and curriculum scope & sequence.

🔊
Read-Aloud Support

Every lesson, story, and instruction can be spoken aloud. Leo the Lion guides younger learners through each activity with his voice.

👤
Multiple Student Profiles

Create separate profiles for each child. Progress, settings, and rewards are kept completely separate for each learner.

🎯
Adjustable Difficulty

Set grade levels per subject. The app adjusts math ranges, writing goals, and reading complexity to match each child's needs.

Getting Started

Up and Running in Minutes

No accounts. No subscriptions. No internet required. Just open the file and begin your child's learning journey.

1
👤
Create a Student Profile

Name your child, choose their grade level, pick an avatar, and give them a companion pet to start their quest.

2
📋
Follow the Daily Plan

Each school day has a suggested lesson plan. The Curriculum Map shows what to cover each week across all 10 subjects.

3
📊
Track Progress Together

Open the Parent Dashboard to review accuracy, attendance, achievements, and export a progress report at any time.

For Parents

You Stay in Control

The parent dashboard is designed for real homeschool families — practical tools that save time without adding complexity.

📈
Progress Tracking

Per-subject accuracy, zone progress, and weekly activity — all in one view.

🎯
Grade Adjustment

Change difficulty per subject any time — no lock-ins, no rigid tracks.

🔐
PIN Protection

Parent settings are PIN-gated so children cannot change grades or reset progress.

📅
Attendance Calendar

See which days each child studied — helpful for portfolio and record-keeping.

📋
Scope & Sequence

View learning objectives by grade and subject — from Pre-K through 5th Grade.

📄
Progress Export

Export a printable report card and progress summary for portfolio requirements.

For Students

Learning Feels Like an Adventure

Children don't just sit and watch — they quest, earn, build, and grow.

🦁
Leo the Lion

Your child's faithful guide through every lesson. Leo cheers, explains, and celebrates every step of the journey.

  • 📖
    Read stories and answer questions

    23 Bible-based reading stories from Pre-K level to 4th Grade, each with comprehension questions.

  • 🏅
    Earn coins and spend them in the shop

    Buy outfits, trophies, and decorations for their profile — a motivating reward loop.

  • ⚔️
    Defeat subject bosses

    Every subject has a unique boss character. Answering questions correctly deals damage and earns victory.

  • 🏘️
    Build a village

    Earn wood, stone, iron and gold to construct buildings in your very own Kingdom village.

  • 🐾
    Care for a companion pet

    Choose a wolf, fox, bee, or axolotl as a companion — feed them with lesson coins to keep them happy.

Inside the App

A Complete Learning World

Clean, readable screens designed for children and parents — no clutter, no distractions.

Kingdom Quest Academy is designed from a Christian worldview, encouraging children to grow in wisdom, diligence, kindness, and faith while learning core subjects. We believe every lesson is an opportunity to honour God — through honest effort, grateful curiosity, and the joy of discovering what He has made.
